description: This file contains documentation and class definitions for an Event Manager system in the Kivy framework, including the abstract class EventManagerBase and related constants for event dispatch modes.

classes.name: EventManagerBase
classes.description: An abstract class for managing dispatching motion events to widgets, with methods start, dispatch, and stop, and attributes for event types and window reference.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Start the manager, bind callbacks, create resources; assigns window.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatch a motion event to widgets; returns True to stop further dispatch.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the manager, unbind callbacks, release resources.
